description: This PHP source file defines the TimesheetActionLog class, which is an entity representing logs of actions performed on timesheets within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like action, comment, date, the user who performed the action, and the associated timesheet, along with getter and setter methods. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to a database table.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLog
classes.description: An entity class representing a log of actions performed on a timesheet, including details such as action type, comments, timestamp, user responsible, and associated timesheet.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the timesheet action log.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of the timesheet action log.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Retrieves the action type performed, such as 'submit', 'approve', etc.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves any comment associated with this log entry.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for this log entry.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the action was performed.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time when the action was performed.

methods.name: getPerformedUser
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the action.

methods.name: setPerformedUser
methods.description: Sets the user who performed the action.

methods.name: setTimesheet
methods.description: Associates this log with a specific timesheet.
